check_hint: When the assistant's user-facing message offers to cancel something from an order, find the order IDs it mentions and look up their item counts in prior order-details tool results. Cancellation applies to the entire pending order, so if the order has more than one item, the message must say that the entire or whole order (all items) would be cancelled. Fail if the message implies cancelling a single item from a multi-item order.
